terra.problem: The passage describes Dedanite caravans but does not say the Dedanites were a trading people. That additional fact needs a supporting reference.
The passage says the refugees flee weapons and battle, but it does not say they fled their homes.
“Just a handful” narrows the number beyond what the passage says. It says the remaining archers will be few.
Kedar is not the last people named in the verse. Israel is named afterward.
